<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Form Validation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
    g_form.hideAllFieldMsgs();

    if (g_form.getValue('want_to_generate_csr') == true || g_form.getValue('want_to_generate_csr') == 'true') {
        if (!g_form.getValue('csr') || g_form.getValue('csr') == '') {
            showFieldErrMsg('csr', getMessage('CSR should not be empty.'), 'error');
            return false;
        }
        var answer = confirm(getMessage("Have you copied or downloaded your private key? Please ensure you have copied or downloaded it before proceeding further."));
        if (!answer)
            return false;
    }

    //Show error message for CSR, if CSR doesn't contain the subject common name
    if (g_form.getValue('csr') != '' && !g_form.getValue('subject_common_name')) {
        showFieldErrMsg('csr', getMessage('Invalid CSR'), 'error');
        return false;
    }

    //Validation for validity period: Allow only numbers greater than zero
    var validityPeriod = g_form.getValue('validity_period');
    var onlyNumberAllowed = /^[0-9]*$/;
    if ((g_form.getValue('certificate_purpose') == 'external') && (validityPeriod != 'undefined') && (validityPeriod.trim() != '') && (validityPeriod.trim() <= 0 || !onlyNumberAllowed.test(validityPeriod))) {
        showFieldErrMsg('validity_period', getMessage('Provide a valid input for validity period'), 'error');
        return false;
    }

    //Validation for subject common name: If certificate purpose is external -> subject common name should not be empty
    if ((g_form.getValue('certificate_purpose') == 'external') && (!g_form.getValue('subject_common_name'))) {
        g_form.addErrorMessage("Invalid CSR. Subject Common Name should not be empty");
        scrollTop();
        return false;
    }

    if (g_form.getValue('private_key_file') && g_form.getValue('private_key_file') != "")
        deletePrivateKeyAttachment();

    function deletePrivateKeyAttachment() {
        var ga = new GlideAjax("global.CSRGeneratorAjax");
        ga.addParam("sysparm_name", "deleteAttachment");
        ga.addParam("sysparm_attachment_sys_id", g_form.getValue('private_key_file'));
        ga.getXML(function(response) {
            response = JSON.parse(response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer"));
        });
    }


    function scrollTop() {
        // top.gsft_main.scrollTo -> if form is on the sub frame , top.scrollTo -> if form is on the main frame
        if (top)
            (top.gsft_main) ? top.gsft_main.scrollTo(0, 0) : top.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }

    function showFieldErrMsg(fieldName, errMsg, msgType) {
        g_form.showFieldMsg(fieldName, errMsg, msgType);
        g_form.getControl(fieldName).focus();
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 17:12:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1b5709e53bcf3610be82c237f4e45a79</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Form Validation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_1b5709e53bcf3610be82c237f4e45a79</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-13 17:12:11</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
